packaged: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
publisher: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

packaged: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.
publisher: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.

packaged: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.
publisher: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.

packaged: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
publisher: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.

packaged: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
publisher: ¶ Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.

packaged: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.
publisher: ¶ If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband’s brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband’s brother unto her.

packaged: And if the man like not to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.
publisher: And if the man like not to take his brother’s wife, then let his brother’s wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband’s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband’s brother.

packaged: Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.
publisher: Then shall his brother’s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother’s house.

packaged: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:
publisher: ¶ When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:

packaged: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
publisher: ¶ Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.

packaged: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
publisher: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

packaged: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the Lord thy God.
publisher: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

packaged: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;
publisher: ¶ Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;

packaged: Therefore it shall be, when the Lord thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.

packaged: I say again, let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
publisher: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

packaged: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
publisher: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

packaged: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
publisher: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

packaged: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long suffering and doctrine.
publisher: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
